name: lucid-api-testing
description: Postman/Newman API test suite for Lucid (onboarding & activation, account, transfers, bills-payment, card), split into independently-runnable collections per domain.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:onboarding && npm run test:account && npm run test:transfers && npm run test:bills && npm run test:card
scripts.test:onboarding: newman run collections/Onboarding.postman_collection.json -e environments/Dev.postman_environment.json -g globals/globals.postman_globals.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/onboarding-report.html
scripts.test:account: newman run collections/Account.postman_collection.json -e environments/Dev.postman_environment.json -g globals/globals.postman_globals.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/account-report.html
scripts.test:transfers: newman run collections/Transfers.postman_collection.json -e environments/Dev.postman_environment.json -g globals/globals.postman_globals.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/transfers-report.html
scripts.test:bills: newman run collections/BillsPayment.postman_collection.json -e environments/Dev.postman_environment.json -g globals/globals.postman_globals.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/bills-report.html
scripts.test:card: newman run collections/Card.postman_collection.json -e environments/Dev.postman_environment.json -g globals/globals.postman_globals.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/card-report.html
